name: Massachusetts

flag.description: A white field with the state arms: a blue shield showing a Native American with a bow and a downward-pointing arrow and a white star, an arm holding a broadsword above, and a blue ribbon with the Latin motto below.
flag.symbolism: The Latin motto means "By the sword we seek peace, but peace only under liberty"; the downward arrow signals peace.

hook: Massachusetts is white, not blue, with a blue shield in the middle showing a single standing figure and a sword-arm above.
trivia: Until 1971 the flag had a different reverse: a green pine tree on a blue shield.
A state commission has been working on a replacement flag since 2024, but the current design remains the official one.
